boundary_notes.source_authority: Mediatheque kOA owns persistent source bytes/snapshots; Kompiler may read source locators but never becomes the source store
boundary_notes.local_inventory: Kristal Manager owns discovery, validation, and GitHub read-surface synchronization; Kompiler only reads.
boundary_notes.semantic_authority: Kristal owns KQ/KP/KA/KS identity, v6-v10 semantic/hosting contracts and crystallization; Kompiler reads them and never mints Kristal identity
boundary_notes.hosting: GitHub sync, qualification, publication and activation are external to Kompiler authority
boundary_notes.kompiler: optional read-only context compiler; emits only Kompiler Context Packs
boundary_notes.daat: external optional Interaction Kernel boundary; not a Kompiler stage

additional_version_policy: Exact bundled pins for observed draft.3 and draft.3.1 contract sets, with explicit operator SHA-256 override permitted after independent verification. A matching version alone is never evidence of a matching standard; no Git commit is assumed.
